notes.title: Visibility Update
notes.content:
Changed the track to slope upward a bit, making it easier to spot any obstacles heading your way.

Other Changes:

Changed the size of super ring
Made all rings easier to spot from a distance

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2/11/2024
notes.content: Fixed a bug where sometimes the tutorial video for flash boost would not play.

notes.title: Demo Updates 1/27/24 - 1/29/24
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141058/e67ff2534ae2b0553c4b09616e3bd2c77edaa519.png
Gameplay Changes

Reduced curvyness of all tracks to improve visibility of obstacles.
Walls can now be broken if you have at least 1 energy core left even if you are not fast enough.
Added a visual aid for flash boost.
Added a tutorial for flash boost.
Added 1 more level.
Added an option to disable flash boost visual from options menu.
Increased the size of normal speed boosts.
Improved UI navigation for keyboard and gamepad.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the screen still remains blurred after a quick restart
Fixed a bug where you get a speed boost if you quick restart at the beginning of a level
Fixed a bug where drilling through a wall will make cracks appear in incorrect orientations
Fixed a bug where you would lose focus during UI navigation with keyboard or gamepad
